name: MojeekBot
follows_en: Yes, obeys the Robots Exclusion Standard; crawl-delay is not supported

ips.note: Mojeek says to reverse-resolve the visiting IP to a name in the mojeek.com domain and forward-resolve it back to the same IP, or to match the IP against its published list of MojeekBot IP addresses.

vendor_quote: MojeekBot is the web crawler for the Mojeek search engine.
what_en: MojeekBot is the web crawler for the Mojeek search engine. Mojeek says it should not request more than one page from a site within the same 1 second period. It obeys the noindex, nocache and nofollow meta tags.
block_en: Mojeek says MojeekBot obeys the first robots.txt record whose User-Agent contains MojeekBot, and otherwise the first record for User-Agent *. It will not retrieve URLs containing a disallowed string. It does not support the nonstandard crawl-delay directive.
compare_en: Both crawl for a search engine; Mojeek publishes a one-range IP list and a reverse DNS check, and does not support crawl-delay.
notes: The vendor page does not show a full user-agent string, only the name MojeekBot, so 'ua' is the name. The IP JSON has one prefix (5.102.173.64/28); Mojeek says the list can be updated at any time. The page says a noindex page is retrieved but not indexed.
answer_en: MojeekBot is the web crawler for the Mojeek search engine. Mojeek says it obeys the Robots Exclusion Standard, using the first record whose User-Agent contains MojeekBot, and does not support the nonstandard crawl-delay directive. It should not request more than one page from a site in the same second.
